reconcile.note: Gill treats the shifting order and different closing item in each list as inconsequential rearrangement, since Paul himself reorders these commandments elsewhere.

discrepancy.note: Remsburg lays the three commandment lists side by side and observes that no two Synoptics agree, with Mark and Matthew each adding an item the others omit.

quotes.text: No two of the Synoptics agree. Mark and Matthew each give a commandment not given by either of the others.
quotes.attr: John E. Remsburg (d. 1919), The Christ: A Critical Review and Analysis of the Evidences of His Existence (1909), §216, on Matthew 19:19 and Mark 10:19.

sides.snippet: 'Do not defraud,' 'Honor your father and mother.'
sides.verseText: You know the commandments: 'Do not murder,' 'Do not commit adultery,' 'Do not steal,' 'Do not give false testimony,' 'Do not defraud,' 'Honor your father and mother.'\"
